hops td create churntraining1e2e16 --version 1 --description "Training dataset for churn prediction, version 1" --query "SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, t.amount, t.balance, p.credit_score, p.tier, a.sessions_7d, h.health_score, l.churned FROM (SELECT account_id, label_time, churned, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY label_time) as rn FROM hopsfs.\"Resources/labels_augmented.csv\" WHERE source = 'labels') l LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT amount, balance FROM hopsfs.\"Resources/transactions_augmented.csv\" WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND event_time <= l.label_time AND source = 'transactions' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) t ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT amount as amount_late, balance as balance_late FROM hopsfs.\"Resources/transactions_late_augmented.csv\" WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND event_time <= l.label_time AND source = 'transactions_late' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) tl ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT credit_score, tier FROM hopsfs.\"Resources/profiles_augmented.csv\" WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND event_time <= l.label_time AND source = 'profiles' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) p ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sessions_7d FROM hopsfs.\"Resources/activity_augmented.csv\" WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND event_time <= l.label_time AND source = 'activity' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) a ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT health_score FROM hopsfs.\"Resources/account_health_augmented.csv\" WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND event_time <= l.label_time AND source = 'account_health' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) h ON true WHERE l.rn = 1" --format csv --json

hops fv create churn_training_view --description "Feature view for churn training dataset" --query "SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, COALESCE(tl.amount, t.amount) as amount, COALESCE(tl.balance, t.balance) as balance, p.credit_score, p.tier, a.sessions_7d, h.health_score, l.churned FROM (SELECT account_id, label_time, churned, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY label_time) as rn FROM churn_raw_data WHERE source = 'labels') l LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, event_time, amount, balance FROM churn_raw_data WHERE source = 'transactions') t ON t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.event_time <= l.label_time LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, event_time, amount, balance FROM churn_raw_data WHERE source = 'transactions_late') tl ON tl.account_id = l.account_id AND tl.event_time <= l.label_time AND tl.event_time > t.event_time LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, event_time, credit_score, tier FROM churn_raw_data WHERE source = 'profiles') p ON p.account_id = l.account_id AND p.event_time <= l.label_time LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, event_time, sessions_7d FROM churn_raw_data WHERE source = 'activity') a ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND a.event_time <= l.label_time LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, event_time, health_score FROM churn_raw_data WHERE source = 'account_health') h ON h.account_id = l.account_id AND h.event_time <= l.label_time WHERE l.rn = 1" --json
hops fv create churn_training_view --feature-group churn_raw_data --description "Feature view for churn training dataset" --json

hops td compute churn_training_view --name churntraining1e2e16 --version 1 --description "Training dataset for churn prediction, version 1" --query "SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, COALESCE(tl.amount, t.amount) as amount, COALESCE(tl.balance, t.balance) as balance, p.credit_score, p.tier, a.sessions_7d, h.health_score, l.churned FROM (SELECT account_id, label_time, churned, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY label_time) as rn FROM churn_raw_data_1 WHERE source = 'labels') l LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, event_time, amount, balance FROM churn_raw_data_1 WHERE source = 'transactions') t ON t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.event_time <= l.label_time LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, event_time, amount, balance FROM churn_raw_data_1 WHERE source = 'transactions_late') tl ON tl.account_id = l.account_id AND tl.event_time <= l.label_time LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, event_time, credit_score, tier FROM churn_raw_data_1 WHERE source = 'profiles') p ON p.account_id = l.account_id AND p.event_time = (SELECT MAX(event_time) FROM churn_raw_data_1 WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND event_time <= l.label_time AND source = 'profiles') LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, event_time, sessions_7d FROM churn_raw_data_1 WHERE source = 'activity') a ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND a.event_time = (SELECT MAX(event_time) FROM churn_raw_data_1 WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND event_time <= l.label_time AND source = 'activity') LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, event_time, health_score FROM churn_raw_data_1 WHERE source = 'account_health') h ON h.account_id = l.account_id AND h.event_time = (SELECT MAX(event_time) FROM churn_raw_data_1 WHERE account_id = l.account_id AND event_time <= l.label_time AND source = 'account_health') WHERE l.rn = 1" --format csv --json
